### 2026-10-10 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FMEKnrb22frjFkpesXrjbdX7wDZPevrf/4365ad4352b021b1b26cd8a25cc362e4b259f00e4be112332fd487c8a4bf1c06.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FMEKnrb22frjFkpesXrjbdX7wDZPevrf/9ff9843b1aa5ae499ccf22038ef846d50fa36aa59920f944a7eea4f71dd8dd35.png)

I followed the Starbie guide and created my own Heartbie! I completed the schematic, PCB, and the firmware.

Some conflicts I faced:
- I wanted to make my PCB board light pink, but when I tried doing it, it became white. So I had to see what makes it light pink as a final look instead of white.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FMEKnrb22frjFkpesXrjbdX7wDZPevrf/a0b8517af27277dd50e1b5564f8eb4339462941e4afb56b90a6df5b3004b23c1.png)

- Connecting the pins with the GNDs. I kept doing the pins to the GND instead of the GND to the pins so it was very weird and it wasn't working. However, when I tried doing it from the GND, it was working so that's how I figured it out.

### 2026-10-11 – Wanted to add a design to my PCB board. Went through multiple sketches of what might look the best(I'm trying to make one that fits one of my OC designs)

**2.3h**

Wanted to add a design to my PCB board. Went through multiple sketches of what might look the best(I'm trying to make one that fits one of my OC designs)

Some problems I encountered:
- exported the design in white(bc it matched my light pink PCB) but turns out it had to be black so I had to redo it in black instead of white
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FMEKnrb22frjFkpesXrjbdX7wDZPevrf/646a0cfe2416a9e2481daec8317c48edd8ca50dbbeda185b306ff65e94a58935.png)
- scaling the image to the right size when using it on the PCB board(trial and error)
- I had to move the components on the right more to the right because the logo was on it, and I had to rewire all the tracks again.

### 2026-10-11 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FMEKnrb22frjFkpesXrjbdX7wDZPevrf/5bb6601579d51239e46fc7b45ae261000b205905272a72571944682d9429bf4d.png)

**3h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FMEKnrb22frjFkpesXrjbdX7wDZPevrf/5bb6601579d51239e46fc7b45ae261000b205905272a72571944682d9429bf4d.png)

I'm having so much trouble finding materials that total less than $30. All of the amazon links listed in the github for the Starbie project are in packs, having higher prices than the unit price shown. Additionally, people are recommending Aliexpress, and although they may be cheaper than Amazon, once you enter the checkout, many of the sales disappear and show a higher price than expected. I was trying to see if I can eliminate some components so I don't go over my budget. I'm planning to erase the shaking function at this point. The PCB itself costs $17 with the lowest shipping available for me, and all the other parts are in total like $20+.
